target: UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one vCPU, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-xcaliber-current-c161-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-xcaliber
verified: X-Caliber reached the game after its popup and maintained graphical keyboard focus.
Plain Right and Left each visibly moved the ship; Space produced a visible projectile in scanout.
Escape restored the graphical terminal; 40+7 evaluated as 47, terminal keyboard input remained usable, and final zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Focused exact-image automated input and terminal-recovery acceptance; not live UTM UI or physical Pi acceptance.
